def _verify_hmac(hash_algorithm_name: str, request, client_secret=None,
    resource_owner_secret=None):
    norm_params = normalize_parameters(request.params)
    bs_uri = base_string_uri(request.uri)
    sig_base_str = signature_base_string(request.http_method, bs_uri, norm_params)
    
    expected_signature = _sign_hmac(hash_algorithm_name, sig_base_str,
                                    client_secret, resource_owner_secret)
    
    match = safe_string_equals(expected_signature, request.signature)
    if not match:
        log.debug('Verify HMAC-%s failed', hash_algorithm_name)
    return match
